title: gzip file format (RFC 1952)
summary: A gzip file consists of a 10-byte header, optional original filename/comment/extra fields, the DEFLATE-compressed payload, and an 8-byte trailer (CRC-32 of the uncompressed data + uncompressed size mod 2^32).

ext.summary: A gzip file consists of a 10-byte header, optional original filename/comment/extra fields, the DEFLATE-compressed payload, and an 8-byte trailer (CRC-32 of the uncompressed data + uncompressed size mod 2^32).

structure.meaning: Flags: FTEXT, FHCRC, FEXTRA, FNAME, FCOMMENT.
Modification time (Unix seconds), or 0 if unknown.
Extra flags: 2 = compressor used max, 4 = fastest.
OS: 0 FAT, 3 Unix, 7 Macintosh, 11 Windows NT, 255 unknown.

ext.example_decoded: Minimal empty gzip stream (10-byte header + empty DEFLATE block + 8-byte trailer)
notes: The trailer's CRC-32 and ISIZE let a reader verify integrity without decompressing.
gzip wraps a single DEFLATE stream; zip wraps many.
